g.text: The final three Functional hierarchy sections are preserved with identical node membership and coordinates.

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: G, each cluster connects to its ten strongest positive Pearson neighbours in the smoothed, within-trial z-scored full-trial matrix; eight communities are the consensus of 100 weighted label-propagation runs. The force

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: layout is display geometry only. H, region composition, the unique undirected cross-region edge budget, weighted-degree hubs and cross-region bridge scores are recomputed from the same graph. I, supplied CW90 electrode

text.style: font-size: 6.45px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #56616f

g.text: coordinates are recolored by community and region. Functional similarity is neither anatomical connectivity nor causal coupling.
